items.criterion: The run ends only in an end state: each change is proposed, or a commit "Stop <id>: <why>" records the stop. It does not end with work half done and no stop record.
A stop gives the user a clear decision. The reply and "Open" in the handoff give the reason in one sentence, the decision, and a recommended answer that obeys the pdlc rules.
Ship does not settle a contradiction by default. It stops and leaves the choice to the user.
Ship continues from the latest handoff and does not run a finished stage again.
Each stage leaves the commit subjects and trailers of its own skill, in the order of "Stages and handoffs".
A case that is not a stop (no remote, a slow agent, a choice of name) does not stop the run.
At the end, `git status --porcelain` is empty, and each commit has the trailers of "Commits".
The last reply lists the changes in stack order with their proposals and GIFs. It also lists each answer taken by default, and what waits for the user.

runs.label: P01#1
runs.note: Ship stopped at ready and recorded a stop. The intent says N must be 10 or less, but its example is --top 20. No change was planned or built. Commits in proj: Specify IN-0001, Ready IN-0001, Stop IN-0001.

verdicts.evidence: Ship recorded the stop (commit "Stop IN-0001: the example of 20 conflicts with the limit of 10").
Reason: R4 (top option) says that `wordfreq --top 20 FILE` prints 20 words. R5 (top limit) says that N must be 10 or less. The two cannot both hold.
Ready kept R4 (top option) and R5 (top limit) as proposed, because they conflict.
Intake (commit "Specify IN-0001: top-option") wrote IN-0001 (top option)
Stop IN-0001: ... / Ready IN-0001: top-option / Specify IN-0001: top-option
JOB-report-word-frequencies: what are the new usage line, the error codes, and the messages? → USAGE, TOP_INVALID and TOP_TOO_LARGE with the messages in the Interface (assumed)

Specify IN-0001: top-option
Intent: IN-0001

Co-Authored-By

runs.note: Ship ran intake, then ready. Ready found that the example (--top 20) contradicts the limit (N must be 10 or less). Ship recorded a stop, so no change, build or pull request exists.
